Container.Name: SourceHub
Container.Overview:
Cross-marketplace product aggregation and price comparison.
Crawls AliExpress, Alibaba, DHgate, Banggood, Made-in-China, Geekbuying, Chinavasion and eBay, matches the same physical product across them, and publishes one item page per product showing every site's price, minimum order quantity and disclosed shipping - translated to English, with forwarding-agent links for the sites that will not ship to the US.
Includes reverse image search, bulk/BOM costing, break-even analysis (at what quantity does wholesale actually win?), price and restock alerts, and a US retail baseline so you can tell whether importing is genuinely cheaper.
IMPORTANT: set SOURCEHUB_ADMIN_TOKEN below. In a container the admin pages are disabled without it, by design - container traffic never looks like loopback, so an unauthenticated admin panel would be exposed to your whole LAN.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Database, downloaded images, browser login profile and the editable YAML config files all live here. Back this up.

Config.Name: Admin Token
Config.Description: REQUIRED to use the admin pages in a container. Any strong random string. Sign in with it as the password (any username). Leave blank and admin returns 403 - browsing and search still work.

Config.Name: Mode
Config.Description: serve = web UI + scheduled crawling (recommended). web = UI only, no crawling. schedule = crawler only, no UI.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID. 99 (nobody) is the Unraid default and keeps appdata editable from the host.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID. 100 (users) is the Unraid default.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone. The crawl schedule in config.yaml is interpreted in this zone.

Config.Name: Translation Provider
Config.Description: claude | deepl | google_free | none. Without translation, Chinese listings cannot be title-matched and mostly stay on their own product pages.

Config.Name: Anthropic API Key
Config.Description: Used when TRANSLATE_PROVIDER=claude. Translations are cached by content hash, so a repeat crawl costs nothing.

Config.Name: eBay Client ID
Config.Description: Free from developer.ebay.com. Without it eBay falls back to browser scraping, which works but is slower.

Config.Name: Proxy
Config.Description: Optional. One http://user:pass@host:port, or several comma-separated for round-robin. Strongly recommended for sustained crawling.

Config.Name: CN Provider Key
Config.Description: Optional API key for Taobao/Tmall/1688 data (see providers.yaml). Without it those three need a one-time browser login, which is awkward in a container.
